# Health Check

A short, project-owned custom procedure kept as migration source evidence. This V1
project only ever exercised the Quick mode; it never adopted Full or Deep.

## Quick Check

Before handing off `E01-example/T001-shared` or `E01-example/T002-follow-up`:

- the shared baseline output still matches the v1 original byte-for-byte where reused;
- `D001-shared` in the active release names the release it belongs to, never the other
  release's record of the same short ID;
- any open audit finding referencing this epic keeps its stable `F###` ID.
